title: What Scripture Actually Says About Debt (It’s Not Just Math)
caption:
"The borrower is the slave of the lender." Proverbs 22:7 isn't a budgeting tip. It's a warning about who owns you.

Debt isn't always a sin. But a man who owes is owned a little, and a man who spends to impress is owned by people who never think about him.

Save this and write down your number this week.

#faith #scripture #money #godlyman #discipline
theme: He runs his life: his impulses don’t control him.
